summary: Completed frontend testing of Avatar and Voice preview functionality in 'Configurações de Avatar' section. All UI components working correctly: avatar grid (50 avatars), avatar preview card with image/name/gender badge, 'Ver Animado' toggle button, voice list (49 voices) with play buttons, voice preview card with 'Selecionada' badge and play button, max scenes input.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Avatar grid (data-testid='avatar-grid') loads with 50 avatar thumbnail options
GOOD: Clicking avatar shows AvatarPreviewCard with image, name, gender badge
GOOD: 'Ver Animado' button (data-testid='avatar-toggle-video-btn') present and clickable
GOOD: Voice list (data-testid='voice-list') shows 49 Portuguese voices with play buttons
GOOD: Voice play buttons (data-testid='play-voice-{id}') are clickable
GOOD: Clicking voice highlights it with violet border and shows VoicePreviewCard
GOOD: VoicePreviewCard shows 'Selecionada' badge and play button (data-testid='selected-voice-play-btn')
GOOD: Max scenes input (data-testid='avatar-limit-input') works correctly
NOTE: Video toggle works but first 5 avatars tested don't have video preview URLs from HeyGen API - this is expected behavior as not all HeyGen avatars have video previews
seed_data_creation: None - used existing course 'Liderança de Impacto'
